title: This Fungus Turns Ants Into Zombies 🧟 #shorts

lines.say: A fungus can turn an ant into a zombie.
lines.headline: This fungus *hijacks* ants

hero.prompt: extreme macro of a single carpenter ant on a green leaf in a dark rainforest, eerie pale fungal threads creeping from its joints

lines.say: And it does it without ever entering its brain.
lines.headline: Without touching its *brain*

hero.prompt: glowing translucent ant head in x-ray style, dark background
hero.title: Not in the brain

lines.say: An infected carpenter ant stops walking with its colony.
lines.headline: Step 1: it *leaves*

hero.prompt: a long trail of carpenter ants on a forest floor at dusk, one ant breaking away from the line
hero.title: Carpenter ant

lines.say: It wanders off alone, up a small plant.
lines.headline: Step 2: it *climbs*

hero.prompt: a lone ant climbing the thin stem of a tiny rainforest sapling, shallow depth of field
hero.title: Alone, up a sapling

lines.say: Then, around solar noon, it bites down hard.
lines.headline: Step 3: it *bites*

lines.say: On a leaf vein, about twenty five centimeters up.
lines.headline: Always the *same height*

lines.say: Its jaw muscles waste away, locking it there.
lines.headline: A *death grip*

hero.prompt: extreme macro of ant mandibles clamped onto a leaf vein, dramatic side light

hero.title: 3D visualization reveals fungal parasite networks in manipulated ants

lines.say: The fungus had wrapped networks around its muscles.
lines.headline: It wraps the *muscles*

hero.prompt: microscopic view of glowing fungal hyphae networks wrapped around striated insect muscle fibers
hero.title: Fungal networks

lines.say: But not a single fungal cell was inside the brain.
lines.headline: And the *brain*?

lines.say: Then a stalk grows out of the ant's head,
lines.headline: The *final* stage

hero.prompt: a thin fungal stalk growing out of the head of a dead ant clinging to a leaf, misty rainforest

lines.say: ready to release spores on new victims.
lines.headline: Spores for *new victims*

hero.prompt: cloud of glowing fungal spores drifting through dark rainforest air, backlit by a golden beam

lines.say: Nature wrote the zombie story first.
lines.headline: Nature wrote it *first*

lines.say: Follow for one fact a day that changes how you see the world.
